subject: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & budget owner map
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Price <alex.price@finhaven.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finhaven.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & budget owner map

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track procurement readiness and the commercial path.

Key points from the call:
- Purchase intent: FinHaven is targeting a pilot (3 months) for anomaly-detection assistant across two product teams; anticipated start: Sep 2026.
- Procurement preference: Primary ask from Priya was whether we support PO-based ordering vs corporate card, and marketplace purchasing (AWS Marketplace).
- Compliance: SOC 2 in place, customer wants confirmation on data residency options for US region.

Immediate asks / open questions for FinHaven:
1) Who is the economic buyer / budget owner for the pilot (name and email)?
2) Who will sign the order (procurement contact / legal signatory)?
3) Is there an existing procurement flow (PO number + AP contact) or do you prefer marketplace order?
4) Any required contract terms/standards (data retention, logging window) we should pre-clear with Legal?

Proposed commercial path (options):
A) Standard Redwood SOW + PO: you issue PO to Redwood; billing to AP contact; typical lead time 7–10 business days after signatures.
B) Marketplace procurement: you purchase via AWS Marketplace (Redwood is listed) — faster procurement in some orgs but license term and invoicing cadence differ.
C) Corporate card: one-off purchase for pilot (small teams), fastest but needs cardholder.

Next steps I propose (please confirm which you prefer):
- Alex/Priya: confirm economic buyer + signatory and whether marketplace is a must-have.
- Jordan: share SOW draft and a short procurement checklist for PO vs Marketplace (attached).
- Rishi / Marissa (internal): we'll prepare a short pricing summary and a Marketplace flow diagram in case FinHaven wants that route.

Attachments: Redwood-SOW_v1.pdf (draft), procurement-checklist.csv

Thanks — I’ll follow up by EOD with the draft SOW.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Price <alex.price@finhaven.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@finhaven.com>
Cc: Sam Rodriguez <sam.rodriguez@finhaven.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & budget owner map

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Economic buyer: that will be me for the pilot (Alex Price, Head of Product Ops) — I own the $ allocation for experimentation budgets. My email: alex.price@finhaven.com.
- Signatory: legal prefers the contract be signed by Priya Desai (Procurement Lead). Priya is CC'd.
- Preferred route: we prefer a PO-based approach for traceability. Marketplace is possible but needs procurement approval due to billing reconciliation constraints.
- AP / invoicing: Sam Rodriguez (sam.rodriguez@finhaven.com) handles invoices and PO issuance.

Timing: if Redwood can provide a SOW plus net-30 invoice terms, we can route for a PO and target signatures by early Aug. If Marketplace is materially faster on your side, share a brief comparison and we can escalate to procurement.

Open items on our end:
- Standard redlines: limited data retention clause required (90 days log retention).
- Need to confirm whether Redwood supports SSO provisioning via SAML (Priya — can you confirm?).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the SOW.

Alex
Head of Product Ops | FinHaven Technologies
alex.price@finhaven.com | +1 (617) 555-4422

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & budget owner map

Jordan — thanks for the thread, adding internal notes for next steps and how we should map approvals (short bullet plan to share with FinHaven).

Internal mapping (recommended):
- Economic buyer: Alex Price (confirmed). We should capture budget code if available for finance routing.
- Finance sponsor / AP contact: Sam Rodriguez — we'll request PO template and AP contact details.
- Legal signatory: Priya Desai — expect standard SLA + 90-day log retention redline.
- Technical approvers: Dev lead (TBD) — send SSO/SAML details and diagram.

Commercial options we can present to FinHaven:
1) PO + Redwood SOW (recommended): net-30 billing; attach SOW; provide invoice to AP; typical turnaround ~ 7–12 business days once PO issued.
2) AWS Marketplace: faster procurement acceptance in some orgs but may require invoice remapping and different license keys — mention possible 30–45 day reconciliation with your finance team.
3) Card: ad-hoc pilot payment if cardholder on team prefers speed; not recommended for enterprise accounting.

Action items for Redwood:
- Jordan: send SOW and procurement-checklist (done).
- Marissa: prepare a short doc comparing PO vs Marketplace pros/cons + an internal billing contact list.
- Rishi: prepare a one-pager on legal redlines and suggested fallback language for the 90-day retention clause.

I'll draft the one-pager and loop Legal if Priya asks for negotiation during signature.

-rishi
Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & budget owner map

Alex / Priya / Sam — looping back with attachments and confirmed next steps.

Attached: Redwood-SOW_v1.pdf (draft) and procurement-checklist.csv. Highlights:
- Billing: we can accept PO with net-30 invoice terms for the pilot; please include budget code on the PO if possible.
- Data retention: we can accommodate 90-day log retention; Rishi has drafted fallback language for legal review.
- Marketplace: we can support AWS Marketplace. If you choose Marketplace, please note license key and invoicing cadence differ; our Marketplace team (Marissa) will run the onboarding and provide a short checklist.

Please confirm the following so we can move to contracting:
1) Alex: confirm budget code and whether you want us to draft the PO template for Sam.
2) Priya: confirm signatory process — should we route SOW to Legal for a quick review before signature?
3) Sam: best email and postal address for invoices; any PO template you prefer?

I’ll schedule a 15-min follow-up with Priya and Sam for next week to walk through the checklist if that helps (propose Thu 7/22 at 11am ET). Let me know a preferred time.

Thanks — Jordan
